title: licence-token-payload
description: The JSON inside a licence token (specs/licensing.md sections 1 and 8). Serialised compact, UTF-8, camelCase; the token carries the exact bytes, so field order and spacing do not matter. Unknown fields are ignored by every till. Since 2026-09-28 a key may carry the shop's details (company) and limits.branches.

companyId.description: Required for source=portal. A local key may leave it blank; since 2026-09-28 every key of one shop (portal or local, one per till) carries the SAME companyId - the main till refuses a LAN join from a till whose key names another company.

branchId.description: Required for source=portal. A local key may leave it blank; every till key of one shop carries the same branchId (the main till refuses a join from a key for another branch).

installCode.description: source=portal (per-till, section 17.15): the installCode of the till that activated the key. source=local: the install the generator made it for; absent, null or empty = an OPEN local key (owner 2026-09-28) - the first till that accepts it binds it to its own install code, and renewals are made for that install code.

maxRegisters.description: Tills allowed in this branch, main till included. The same value in every till key of the branch; the portal counts the branch's activated tills against it (section 17.16).

features.description: Paid features. multi_branch = the company may add branches (up to limits.branches).

validFrom.description: Start of the licence period; with expiresAt it is the length the admin chose (days, months, years).

expiresAt.description: Required - there are no lifetime licences.

limits.description: Open map; limits.branches = how many branches the company may run (1 when absent).

signerCert.description: The signer certificate (docs/web-portal-api.md 17.17). Required in every token signed by a key that is not built into the till (the portal's): the owner's key generator approved that key. Absent for built-in keys.

allOf.description: local: bound to installCode, or an open key (installCode absent/empty) bound by the first till that accepts it.
